Se retornara al menu por inactividad!
The level editor is in a VERY early access.
Lots of features are incomplete or very Buggy
Here's a list of all inputs shortcuts:
- O: Pause the level while playing
- Number keys: Alternate between the selected
- Q - E: Zoom in and Zoom out
- Control C + Control V: Clipboard support(Very
- The Save feature was temporarily removed
due to it being very buggy
